 1 November Rule Change: Several important rule changes are scheduled or expected from November 1, 2026, affecting pensioners, taxpayers, businesses, vehicle owners and bank customers. In this video, we explain 9 key updates related to life certificates for pensioners, the ITR filing deadline for tax-audit cases, LPG cylinder prices, fixed deposit interest rates, local toll passes, GST amendments, CNAP caller name display, Delhi-NCR pollution measures, railway ticket booking and credit card charges.
